notes: Entry card = Krak Card (Krak app; same Everyday account as the Kraken-branded Debit Card, which is UK/EEA only). Card is in the UK, EEA and US. Fees: bank (ACH/SEPA/FPS) and crypto deposits are free; funding by debit card or Apple/Google Pay costs 0.25 + 3.75%. Yield: USDG Stablecoin Rewards 4.00% on the Krak balance outside the EEA (USDC 2% in US/CA/AU/UK); EEA users only have opt-in Vaults (4.2%-5.27% APY, Krak keeps 25% of yield). Credit: card is prepaid top-up (MEXC Loans exist but are not linked to the card). notes: Two issuers: Rain (most countries, incl. US/UAE/LatAm) and DCS (AU, JP, MY, PH, SG, KR, TW, TH, VN). Deposits: USDC/USDT on Solana free (min $3); other networks at least $0.30 (0.02% stablecoins) plus gas. Purchases: no fee in USD; FX 1% (Rain) / 1.8% (DCS) on non-USD. Standard virtual card: no issuance fee listed in the fee table (only the $25 Claynosaurz design); docs say card orders are non-refundable. Physical: $13.13 plus shipping (shipping not published, shown in app; $30 off tracked shipping with >= $1,500 balance, which covers US tracked shipping); physical cards still rolling out (full rollout by end 2026), so 13.13 excludes shipping. Banking (Global Fiat Remittance via Noah): personal USD and EUR virtual accounts (EUR may depend on residence; bank deposits paused in CA, NY, CT, PR); deposits cost e.g. SEPA EUR 0.87 + 0.10%, ACH $2 + 0.05%. Payouts: 15 local-payout currencies plus SWIFT (fees e.g. EUR $1 + 0.10%); Noah restricts some regions (e.g. UK residents: no EUR/USD off-ramp). Only USDC (not USDT) can be cashed out, and DCS-issued card holders cannot withdraw at all yet. No yield on the Spend balance (Jupiter Lend Earn is a separate product, not the card balance).

No per-purchase fee on USD spend. Virtual and physical card and shipping are $0. Credit: legally a 0% APR 'credit card' secured by collateral (non-stables count at up to 50% of value), but Rain liquidates collateral to repay charges once a day or within 6 hours of each purchase, so in practice it is a debit-style spend of your crypto, not a borrow-to-spend line; set false.
